sourceProvenance: Local asset supplied by the user. Original GF9 third-expansion Spice Card faces; no claim about its earlier upstream download history.

sourceRow.cellBoundaryRule: round(index * 5272 / 7), giving 753 or 754 pixels per full-card crop. Source lower row is black and excluded.

processing: Lossless PNG extraction. No resizing or RGB resampling. Outside-map alpha is cleared using the recorded circle-and-pips mask to remove adjacent large-six/Add ink while preserving protruding pips. Badge alpha uses a circle.
productionRegistration: All /card-art/local-* paths are prototype-only. Register the source-derived images in the maintained media catalogue and bind production references before authenticated Save or Publish. Full card references are review evidence, not additional production cards.
stableLayerIdentity: Each existing map decal UUID is retained. Each original production body text UUID now owns the minimal Add procedure. The prior prototype spice-heading UUID now owns the large six. New spice glyph decals have new UUIDs.
use: Full-card reference images only. Proposed cards use the existing linked-board renderer, not cropped map or badge artwork.

symbols.decision: Use existing Discovery token-back vectors only. Newly authored icons rejected.
